races.paceDynamic: Pleasant Man appears the only potential pace angle but his prominent style suggests he'll settle rather than truly lead, creating a crawling gallop over this 1m2f trip. With 11 hold-up horses behind him, this becomes a tactical crawl followed by a furlong-and-a-half sprint finish where positioning and timing will be crucial.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Tactical Crawl Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasant Man settles too readily and creates pedestrian fractions
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainably slow with the field bunched turning for home, creating a cavalry charge finish. Latin and One Million Dreams benefit most from the strong gallop this creates in the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Pleasant Man Dictates
scenarios.trigger: If Pleasant Man maintains a genuine gallop and avoids the pack
scenarios.body: His sustained tempo stretches the field and allows the best travellers to get first run on those further back. Zambezi Magic and Under The Sun can position closer and benefit from the honest pace.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Bunch Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the crawling pace creates traffic problems and interference in the straight
scenarios.body: Several fancied runners get hampered or stuck behind faltering horses in a congested finish. Outsiders who get clear runs like Magic Runner and Crafter can capitalize on the chaos.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Going Deteriorates Impact
scenarios.trigger: If the good ground rides slower than expected during the card
scenarios.body: The going-dependent runners struggle while those proven on varied surfaces gain a significant edge. Volto Di Medusa and Zambezi Magic benefit as half the field underperforms.
